subject: gh-aw
tagline: GitHub Agentic Workflows = Actions + Agent + Safety. Write agentic workflows in natural language markdown and compile them to sandboxed GitHub Actions YAML.

modules.name: cmd/gh-aw-wasm
modules.description: WASM build of compiler for browser/editor use

modules.name: pkg/workflow
modules.description: Workflow compiler: parses markdown frontmatter, emits compiled GitHub Actions YAML lock files with SHA-pinned actions, safe-output handlers, sandbox wiring

modules.name: pkg/cli
modules.description: CLI commands (add, compile, run, logs, status, fix, update, install)

modules.name: pkg/actionpins
modules.description: SHA pinning and supply-chain verification for referenced actions

modules.name: pkg/tty
modules.description: TTY helpers for interactive run mode

modules.name: pkg/gitutil / repoutil / envutil / fileutil / stringutil / timeutil / sliceutil / semverutil / typeutil / testutil / console / constants / types
schemas
modules.description: JSON schemas (agent-output.json) for validating engine output

modules.name: actions
modules.description: Shared GitHub Action steps used by compiled workflows

modules.name: .github/workflows
modules.description: Smoke and agentics workflows (~272 .md source + ~196 .lock.yml compiled)

entry_points.command: `gh aw mcp-server` — gh-aw itself exposable as an MCP server

capabilities.name: Markdown-as-DSL for agentic workflows
capabilities.description: Workflows are .md files with YAML frontmatter + natural-language body; 272 sample workflows in .github/workflows/.

capabilities.name: Compile to GitHub Actions lock file
capabilities.description: `gh aw compile` deterministically emits a .lock.yml with security hardening; commit both .md and .lock.yml.

capabilities.name: Multi-engine support
capabilities.description: Pluggable coding-agent engines: Copilot (default), Claude, Codex, Gemini, Crush (experimental). Pinable via `engine.version`.

capabilities.name: Safe outputs (validated write ops)
capabilities.description: AI agents run read-only by default; writes (comment, PR, issue, etc.) flow through a vetted `safe-outputs` handler job with size caps and field whitelisting.

capabilities.name: AWF agent sandbox (firewall)
capabilities.description: Default `sandbox.agent: awf` runs the coding agent inside Agent Workflow Firewall with domain-based network egress control.

capabilities.name: MCP gateway
capabilities.description: Experimental feature routes all MCP server calls through a single HTTP gateway for unified auth and logging.

capabilities.name: Human approval gates
capabilities.description: `on.manual-approval` uses GitHub Environments protection rules to require human approval before a workflow triggers.

capabilities.name: Tool allow-listing
capabilities.description: Frontmatter `tools:` + `tools.github.allowed:` whitelists exact capabilities per workflow.

capabilities.name: SHA-pinned dependencies
capabilities.description: All referenced GitHub Actions are pinned to commit SHAs with automated validation; supply-chain hardening.

capabilities.name: Secret redaction in logs
capabilities.description: Built-in regex patterns (GitHub/Azure/Google/AWS/OpenAI/Anthropic) redact secrets in compiled workflow logs.

capabilities.name: Dual concurrency control
capabilities.description: Per-workflow (keyed by issue/PR/branch) and per-engine (default `gh-aw-{engine-id}`) concurrency groups prevent resource exhaustion.

capabilities.name: Installable via gh extension
capabilities.description: `gh extension install github/gh-aw` delivers the CLI as a GitHub-native extension.

capabilities.name: Interactive TUI run mode
capabilities.description: Charmbracelet-based TUI for interactive dry runs and demos.

capabilities.name: Workflow marketplace via `gh aw add`
capabilities.description: `gh aw add owner/repo/path@ref` installs reusable workflows with `resources:` auto-fetch and `redirect:` chains for moved workflows.

capabilities.name: Cost/rate-limiting controls
capabilities.description: Stop-after deadlines, skip-roles/skip-bots guards, engine.concurrency, cost dashboards via `gh aw logs`.

capabilities.name: Claude skill system for authoring
capabilities.description: 22 scoped skills guide agents through authoring, debugging, safe-output config, troubleshooting.

capabilities.name: WASM compiler
capabilities.description: Compiler is shipped as WASM for editor/browser integrations (e.g., live validation).

skills.mechanism: Skill markdown packs discovered by the agent

resources.mechanism: resources: companion files fetched by `gh aw add`

unique_selling_points: Zero custom runtime — runs on standard GitHub Actions infrastructure; no vendor lock-in beyond GitHub itself
Security-first: AWF firewall, safe-outputs, SHA-pinned actions, secret redaction, approval gates, read-only default
Markdown-native agentic DSL — workflows are readable/diff-able like prose
Multi-engine support with per-engine feature matrix (Copilot/Claude/Codex/Gemini/Crush)
Companion ecosystem: gh-aw-firewall, gh-aw-mcpg (MCP gateway), gh-aw-actions

limitations.description: Tied to GitHub Actions runtime — not portable to GitLab CI, Jenkins, or self-hosted orchestrators without adaptation.
No durable event-log replay — relies on GitHub Actions job/step model; failure recovery is at the Actions workflow_run level, not at individual LLM steps.
Using agentic workflows requires careful security review; README explicitly warns 'things can still go wrong'.
Pre-1.0 versioning (v0.40.1 as of CHANGELOG); some features experimental (MCP Gateway, Crush engine).
Project paused during a 'Spring Break' note in README — potential short-term maintenance delays.
